rows._auroc_convention: auroc_prob_as_ood: AUROC with prob as the score and OOD as the positive class (higher prob = more OOD, the convention this hinge trains for). auroc_neg_prob: AUROC with -prob as the score; legacy standard-EBM convention (would be > 0.5 if model put low prob on OOD).
